badges.name: First Steps
badges.description: Earn the normal star on the first level of Chapter 1.

badges.name: First Plan
badges.description: Finish a match in which you set a game plan and made at least one trade.

badges.name: Quick Learner
badges.description: Answer every check question right on the first try in 10 levels.

badges.name: Risk Manager
badges.description: Finish a match with a stop-loss order on every stock you bought and a worst drawdown of 2% or less.

badges.name: Sniper
badges.description: Place 5 limit orders in finished matches and keep them open until they fill or the match ends. A limit order fills only at your price or better.

badges.name: Fee Fighter
badges.description: Finish a choppy or range-bound market with at least 3 trades and under $30 in fees.

badges.name: Cool Head
badges.description: Finish a match with at least 3 orders in which no buy after a sale is larger than the buy before it.

badges.name: Patient Trader
badges.description: Finish a match within your loss limit with at least one order, placing none before 40% of the days had passed.

badges.name: Explorer
badges.description: Earn every special star in one chapter, including the boss.

badges.name: Streak Master
badges.description: Claim the login reward 30 days in a row.

badges.name: Ranked Debut
badges.description: Complete 5 ranked matches without leaving early.

badges.name: Calibrated
badges.description: Mark 20 or more quiz answers "Sure" and get at least 85% of them right.
